goal: Is ke baad aap bata sakein ge ke function kya hai aur kyun faida mand hai, function ke hisson (header, body, call) ke naam bata sakein ge, main() ke upar ek saada function likh sakein ge, aur samajh sakein ge ke control kaise function ke andar jata hai aur wapas aata hai.
warmup: Ek masroof canteen socho. Manager khud khana nahi pakata, plates nahi dhota aur payment nahi leta. Woh khane ke liye cook ko bulata hai, payment ke liye cashier ko aur safai ke liye helper ko. Har worker ek kaam karta hai aur usay baar baar bulaya ja sakta hai. C++ program mein main() manager hai aur har function ek worker. Ek bara program chote chote asaan kaamon ki team ban jata hai.
definition: Function code ka ek naam wala block hota hai jo ek khaas kaam karta hai. Woh sirf tab chalta hai jab aap usay call karte hain. Bare program ko chote functions mein baant dene ko modular programming kehte hain (module ka matlab ek chota hissa). Function ka ek header hota hai (return type, name, parameter list) aur ek body (statements jo { } ke andar hon). Functions kyun use karein? 1) Reusability: ek dafa likho, kai dafa call karo. 2) Readability: main() chota aur parhne mein asaan ho jata hai. 3) Testing aur debugging asaan: har worker ko alag test karo. 4) Teamwork: alag alag log alag alag functions likh sakte hain. 5) Copy-paste se chhutkara: kai jagah repeated code nahi hota.
howItWorks: Pipeline par Play dabayein aur ek call dekhein. main chal raha hai. Usay add(a, b) jaisi call milti hai aur woh RUK jata hai. Arguments ki values function ke parameters mein copy ho jati hain. Function ki body upar se chalna shuru hoti hai. Jab woh return tak pohanchta hai to function khatam ho jata hai aur jawab call wali jagah par wapas chala jata hai. Phir main agle step se chalta rehta hai. Trace ka call stack dekhein: yeh 'kaun kis ka intezar kar raha hai' ka dher hai. main sab se neeche hota hai. Jab main kisi function ko call karta hai to woh function us ke upar rakh diya jata hai. Jab function khatam hota hai to hata diya jata hai aur main phir upar aa jata hai. Is lesson mein functions main() ke UPAR likhe gaye hain, is liye jab main unhein call karta hai to compiler unhein pehle hi dekh chuka hota hai. (Unhein main ke neeche likhne ke liye prototype chahiye, jo agle hafte aayega.)
